meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以管理 NanoClaw 的 OpenCode 代理提供商。它会复制 OpenCode 源文件、添加依赖、更新 Dockerfile，并验证构建。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 OpenCode 代理支持，或需要配置 OpenRouter、DeepSeek 等非 Anthropic 模型提供商时触发。

say.text: 为 NanoClaw 添加 OpenCode 代理支持。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can manage the OpenCode agent provider for NanoClaw. It copies OpenCode source files, adds dependencies, updates the Dockerfile, and validates the build.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add OpenCode agent support to NanoClaw, or needs to configure non-Anthropic model providers like OpenRouter or DeepSeek.

say_en.text: Add OpenCode agent support to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Skill copies files, installs dependencies, and rebuilds the image.

say_en.text: Configure OpenCode to use DeepSeek model.
